scripts.test:cucumber:headless:video: yarn test:prepare && CUCUMBER_VIDEO=1 CUCUMBER_HEADLESS=1 bash scripts/cucumber-runner.sh verbose
scripts.test:cucumber:workers:headless:video:all: yarn test:prepare && CUCUMBER_VIDEO=1 CUCUMBER_HEADLESS=1 FEATURE_LOCALE=pt-br bash scripts/cucumber-runner.sh verbose --parallel "${CUCUMBER_PARALLEL:-4}"; CUCUMBER_VIDEO=1 CUCUMBER_HEADLESS=1 FEATURE_LOCALE=eng bash scripts/cucumber-runner.sh verbose --parallel "${CUCUMBER_PARALLEL:-4}"
scripts.test:api: yarn test:prepare && CUCUMBER_VIDEO=0 CUCUMBER_HEADLESS=1 bash scripts/cucumber-runner.sh verbose --tags "@api"
scripts.allure:open: OZONE_PLATFORM=x11 WAYLAND_DISPLAY= BROWSER='bash scripts/open-maximized.sh' node node_modules/allure-commandline/bin/allure open allure-report 2>&1 | sed '/Wayland Proxy/d;/WaylandProxy::SetupWaylandDisplays/d;/Failed to open Wayland display/d'
scripts.allure:serve: OZONE_PLATFORM=x11 WAYLAND_DISPLAY= BROWSER='bash scripts/open-maximized.sh' node node_modules/allure-commandline/bin/allure serve allure-results 2>&1 | sed '/Wayland Proxy/d;/WaylandProxy::SetupWaylandDisplays/d;/Failed to open Wayland display/d'
